dog.description_text:
Meet Diamond!

Found as a stray, Diamond is a sweet and social girl who loves getting attention from her people. She approaches readily, has a loose and wiggly body, and may even roll over to show you her belly! With her sparkling personality and affectionate nature, Diamond is ready to shine in a forever home.

My Ideal Home

Diamond will love a family who can give her plenty of opportunities to explore, play, and keep her curious mind busy. Walks, playtime, food puzzles, long lasting chews, and fun games like hide and seek can all help her stay happy and engaged. She's ready to be a little gem in the life of someone who enjoys an active companion!

Good with Other Pets?

Diamond's history with other dogs is unknown, so we're still getting to know her around canine friends. When meeting a new dog, she can take some time to feel comfortable and may watch from a little distance before deciding what she thinks. Slow, patient, and supervised introductions will give Diamond the best chance to make new friends at her own pace.

Good with Kids?

Diamond's history with children is unknown, so introductions should be thoughtful and supervised. She is very social with people and enjoys attention, making her a lovely candidate for a family who can give her time to settle in and get comfortable.

Things to Know

Diamond can be a little enthusiastic on leash and may become focused when she spots another dog. Reward based training can help her learn to check in with her person instead, and a front clip harness may make walks more comfortable for everyone. She is comfortable with handling and has a wonderfully affectionate side that comes out when she is feeling relaxed and connected with her people!
